name: Secure Content Protector
author: iSmart Web Service

sections.description:
Secure Content Protector helps WordPress site owners safeguard their digital assets by disabling right-click, text selection, and content copying.

How it’s Work

  1. After insall plugin you can check it -> Open your website on crome Incognito.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/secure-content-protector/ directory or install through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Plugin works automatically
